file_list_assertion: All 20 accession-scoped RAWs mapped exactly once; Fresh, DMSO, DEX and PRED each have five numbered files.
biological_evidence: Publication Methods identify primary human neutrophils isolated from buffy coats, lysed fresh or incubated with 0.1% DMSO, dexamethasone, or prednisolone for 2 h. Filenames encode treatment and sample code 1-5. Codes are retained without asserting same-donor pairing across arms. Donor sex, age and disease status not available.
technical_evidence: PRIDE sample protocol and publication Methods specify PAC digestion with trypsin and Lys-C, Zr-IMAC phosphopeptide enrichment, Orbitrap Astral with Evosep Eno Whisper Zoom, 480-1080 m/z and 4 m/z isolation. Publication raw analysis uses Spectronaut direct DIA+, supporting DIA acquisition.
limitations: The depositor did not state whether sample code 1-5 denotes donors or independent cultures; represented as biological replicate indices within each arm without cross-arm donor linkage.
